# Parsidion Vault Configuration
#
# Place at ~/ParsidionVault/config.yaml
# Values here override script defaults. CLI arguments override these values.
# Precedence: defaults → config.yaml → config.local.yaml → CLI args
#
# config.local.yaml (same directory, always gitignored) is an optional overlay
# merged over this file section-by-section, local values winning on conflict.
# Use it to keep secrets or machine-specific overrides out of config.yaml.
#
# GENERATED BODY: every section and key below is generated from
# skills/parsidion/scripts/core/vault_schema.py by scripts/gen_config_docs.py
# (make config-docs). Values shown are the template-recommended value when one
# exists, otherwise the code default (null = no default / feature disabled).
# Do not hand-edit below this header — change the schema and regenerate.

ai:
  backend: auto  # auto | claude-cli | codex-cli | grok-cli | none

ai_models:
  claude:
    small: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
    large: claude-sonnet-4-6
  codex:
    small: gpt-5.5
    large: gpt-5.5

model: claude-haiku
enabled: true
ratio: 0.5
missing: null
tilde: ~
sure: yes
unsure: no
